name: Academic Achievement Center
description: Academic coaching, workshops, peer mentoring through UConn Connects, and supplemental instruction to help you build study strategies and reach academic goals.

name: Biology Tutoring Center (B Center)
description: Free peer tutoring for life science courses listed under BIOL, EEB, MCB, and PNB. Check the campus page for current availability and details.
eligibility: Students taking eligible UConn Hartford biology courses

name: Quantitative Learning Center (Q Center)
description: Peer tutoring and review sessions for quantitative intensive undergraduate courses. Consult the schedule page to find current sessions and appointment options.
eligibility: UConn Hartford undergraduate students in supported courses

name: Writing Center
description: Undergraduate and graduate tutors can work with you at any stage of an assignment, from early ideas to drafts. The center also offers e-tutoring; check the site for current hours and booking details.

name: Mental Health Resource Center
description: A campus Mental Health Case Manager can talk through concerns affecting student life and connect you with campus or community resources. Contact the office to schedule an appointment; the site describes urgent referral options.
cost: Campus support; ask about any outside service costs

name: UConn Hartford Student Services
description: A welcoming place to start if you are unsure which campus office can help. Student Services can route questions about personal issues, academics, student life, and other campus services.

name: Financial Aid at UConn Hartford
description: For questions about financial aid, start with UConn Hartford's financial aid information and contact options. Ask the office about your individual eligibility, deadlines, and available aid.

name: Find Food & Meal Assistance
description: UConn Hartford Advocacy & Community Engagement links students to local food and meal assistance resources. Follow the official page to see current referrals and details before visiting a provider.
cost: Varies by provider; many food assistance programs are free

name: 2-1-1 Connecticut Resource Finder
description: Search Connecticut community services, including food, housing, utility, and other basic-needs support. Call 2-1-1 or use the online directory to confirm eligibility and availability.
eligibility: Anyone in Connecticut; individual programs set their own eligibility

name: Career Services
description: UConn Hartford Student Services lists Career Services as a campus resource. Use the official student services page to connect with career support and ask about appointments, jobs, resumes, and internships.

name: Student Activities & Organizations
description: Explore student organizations, leadership programs, and activities to meet people and get involved on campus. Check UConn Hartford's university life page for current ways to participate.
cost: Varies by activity; ask the organizer

name: Academic Advising
description: Talk with an assigned advisor about degree progress, requirements, and academic planning. If you are not sure where to begin with a non-advising question, the Office of Student Services can direct you.
eligibility: UConn Hartford undergraduates; some programs have assigned advisors
